registered_before: any figure of the new window existed

comparison_book.note: the frozen trailing-exit ruleset, run on the same new window with the same costs, risk policy and simulator; declared here so the comparison arm cannot be picked after the fact

window_new.name: NEW_HOLDOUT
window_new.source: BINANCE_PUBLIC_REST:/api/v3/klines, interval 1h, aggregated to 4h by edge01.data.resample

risk_policy: config/risk.yaml through edge01.campaign.load_risk_policy; no arm may size, relax a limit or add a cooldown
fills: campaign simulator: signal at the close of bar i, fill at the open of i+1, gap through the stop fills at the open, stop before target inside a bar, open position settled at the window's last bar

metrics.primary: edge01.campaign._metrics, unchanged, so a figure here means what it meant for the frozen books

added.expectancy_ci_90: trade-block bootstrap, 1,000 resamples of 20-trade blocks, seed 20261014
added.time_blocks: three equal consecutive thirds of the window, net per third
added.by_asset: net, trades and expectancy per asset
added.by_market_context: the benchmark-relative label the campaign already records
added.serial_dependence: lag-1 autocorrelation of trade returns with a +/-2/sqrt(n) band, plus a runs test on the sign sequence

criteria.statement: largest single trade <= 50% of the net
net still > 0 with the single largest winner removed
net > 0 in at least 2 of the 3 equal consecutive time blocks
per-asset, per-context and bootstrap readings are reported, never decisive

verdicts.ADMIT_PAPER: every decisive criterion passes on NEW_HOLDOUT; admission to paper only, no live trading, no capital
verdicts.REJECT: a decisive criterion failed with power (P1 with net <= 0, or P4, R1, R2, S1, or a negative DEV gross)
verdicts.INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE: P1 fails while the rest is non-negative, or P5 fails, or coverage is below the declared minimum, or the window could not be built

consequences.on_reject: reported with its numbers; the family is not tuned and re-run on this window
consequences.on_insufficient: reported as no result, never as a pass
